# Derived outputs (generated by analysis/derived.py)

## 1. Placebo-adjusted weight change in matched molecule pairs

| Agent | Dose | Weeks | ETD no T2D (pp) | ETD T2D (pp) | Gap (pp) | Ratio T2D/no-T2D | Design |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Semaglutide s.c. | 2.4 mg weekly | 68/68 | -12.4 | -6.2 | +6.2 | 0.5 | Separate trials, same programme, same estimand (treatment policy) |
| Semaglutide s.c. (HFpEF) | 2.4 mg weekly | 52/52 | -10.7 | -6.4 | +4.3 | 0.6 | Harmonised protocols; prespecified IPD pool; heterogeneity p<0.0001 (I2 95.8%) |
| Tirzepatide | 10 mg weekly | 72/72 | -16.4 | -9.6 | +6.8 | 0.59 | Separate trials, same programme, treatment-regimen estimand |
| Tirzepatide | 15 mg weekly | 72/72 | -17.8 | -11.6 | +6.2 | 0.65 | Separate trials, same programme, treatment-regimen estimand |
| Orforglipron (oral) | 36 mg daily | 72/72 | -9.1 | -7.1 | +2.0 | 0.78 | Separate trials, same programme, treatment-regimen estimand |
| Orforglipron (oral) | 12 mg daily | 72/72 | -6.3 | -4.5 | +1.8 | 0.71 | Separate trials, same programme, treatment-regimen estimand |
| Cagrilintide + semaglutide | 2.4/2.4 mg weekly | 68/68 | -17.3 | -10.4 | +6.9 | 0.6 | Separate trials, same programme, treatment-policy estimand |
| Maridebart cafraglutide | highest-response arm in each cohort | 52/52 | -13.7 | -10.6 | +3.1 | 0.77 | Single protocol, two cohorts; dose/escalation arms differ between cohorts; GIPR antagonist |

Liraglutide 3.0 mg (kg, abstract data): placebo-adjusted -5.6 kg (no T2D) vs -4.2 kg (T2D); ratio 0.75.

Across the 8 %-based comparisons: ratio median 0.62 (range 0.50-0.78); absolute gap median +5.2 pp (range +6.9 to +1.8).
Caveat: comparisons are between populations, not randomised by diabetes status; pairs are not independent (two doses from the same trials).

## 2. STEP 1 implied normoglycaemic subgroup

Overall semaglutide arm -14.9% (n=1306); prediabetes -13.7% (n=593) -> implied normoglycaemia ~-15.9% (n=713).
Graded pattern (cross-trial, unadjusted): normoglycaemia ~-15.9% > prediabetes -13.7% > T2D (STEP 2) -9.6% on the same dose and duration.

## 3. Energy-balance anchors (measured inputs; kcal/day)

- Bogardus 1986 (obese T2D, FPG 253->144 mg/dL; urine glucose 128->11 g/d): 439 kcal/day
- Carlson & Campbell 1993 (T1D; glycosuria 428->39 mmol/d): 263 kcal/day
- Ferrannini G 2015 (empagliflozin-induced glycosuria, T2D): 206 kcal/day
- Rave 2006 clamp: UGE if sustained 24 h at 7.8 mmol/L (0.06 mmol/min): 58 kcal/day
- Rave 2006 clamp: UGE if sustained 24 h at 13.3 mmol/L (0.77 mmol/min): 749 kcal/day
- Bogardus 1986 RMR fall with sulfonylurea (1.7 kcal/kg FFM/day x FFM 55-60 kg): 93-102 kcal/day

Conversion: 3.75 kcal/g glucose; 23.9 kcal/day per kg steady-state (Hall 2011); exponential approach with half-time 1 year.

## 4. Scenario estimates for a trial-like T2D population (assumption-driven)

| Scenario | Differential glycosuria reduction (g/d) | kcal/d retained | Differential REE fall (kcal/d) | Total (kcal/d) | Steady-state kg | kg by wk 68 | kg by wk 72 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Low | 10 | 38 | 0 | 38 | 1.6 | 0.9 | 1.0 |
| Central | 25 | 94 | 40 | 134 | 5.6 | 3.3 | 3.4 |
| High | 45 | 169 | 90 | 259 | 10.8 | 6.4 | 6.7 |

Interpretation: these are upper-bound-style what-if calculations; they assume no behavioural compensation and that the 
differential (drug minus placebo) change in glycosuria/REE persists. Observed placebo-adjusted gap STEP1 vs STEP2 ~6 pp (~6 kg at ~100 kg).
